articles.title: BofA adds January Fed hike to forecast, says quarterly pace no longer enough
articles.desc: BofA Global Research anticipates that the Federal Reserve will implement a rate hike in January 2027. This adjustment follows the unexpectedly high Consumer Price Index report for October. Expectations of a 25-basis-point increase are supported by increasing inflation driven by various factors. Other banks like Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank have also revised their forecasts in light of recent data.

articles.title: US stocks: US stocks reverse early gains as Nvidia turmoil hits tech sector
articles.desc: US stocks fell as Nvidia’s leadership turmoil triggered a broad technology selloff, sending the Nasdaq down 1.42% and the S&P 500 nearly 1% lower. Softer-than-expected producer inflation offered little relief as investors weighed the outlook for interest rates and the wider AI trade.

articles.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says on CNBC the Fed needs to guard against demand overheating
articles.desc: Chicago Fed president Austan Goolsbee stated that inflation has moved beyond temporary energy and tariff-related price shocks. He highlighted that increased demand from the AI buildout is pushing prices higher across many sectors including health care and services. Goolsbee emphasized the importance of upcoming inflation data for determining the Fed's rate increase pace. He noted that currently, there is no clear path back to the 2% inflation target.

articles.title: US Treasury chief says Fed should not hike rates over energy shock tied to Iran war
articles.desc: During his speech, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent advocated for the Federal Reserve to keep an open mind about interest rate adjustments. He pointed out that the current economic indicators could be skewed due to a supply shock from the ongoing conflict in Iran. Despite recent market volatility, Bessent stressed that the US economy remains robust.

articles.title: MAN Industries PAT rises to Rs 82 cr in Q2
articles.desc: MAN Industries (India) Ltd has announced a substantial increase in consolidated profit after tax during the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations also saw a notable rise year-on-year, reflecting strong performance. The acquisition of National Pipe Company has positively impacted scale and profitability for the firm. Shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz temporarily affected revenue but shipments are being executed.

articles.title: US assures India lower tariffs than peers in trade deal
articles.desc: The US has assured India of lower tariffs than those imposed on its trading partners under the proposed trade deal. The first phase of the agreement will cover goods, with services to be negotiated separately in the next phase.

Godrej Properties buys 31-acre land in Indore for Rs 130 cr to build housing project
articles.desc: Godrej Properties Ltd has successfully purchased a sprawling 31 acres of land in Indore for approximately Rs 130 crore. The company is set to embark on the creation of residential plots, providing an impressive saleable area of around 0.7 million square feet. This project marks the firm's third venture in Indore, reflecting a commitment to addressing the rising demand for thoughtfully designed communities.

articles.title: German yields set for biggest weekly rise in two months
articles.desc: As traders ramp up their expectations for European Central Bank interest rate hikes, yields on German government bonds are climbing steadily. This shift follows US inflation figures that were unexpectedly high, disrupting the bond market landscape. Meanwhile, global stock indices are witnessing a downturn, impacting the demand for traditionally safe assets.

articles.title: India 10-year bond yield reverses half of last week's drop on elevated inflation
articles.desc: Indian government bonds fell for a third consecutive session, driven by inflation and interest-rate outlook concerns. The benchmark yield increased to 7.3079%, reversing much of last week's gains. Retail inflation in India accelerated, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's target range, which raises rate hike expectations. In the US, rising Treasury yields and inflation data led to altered rate hike projections.

articles.title: How US tech pain is European stock markets' gain
articles.desc: European stock markets, particularly the STOXX 600, are performing well as tech turmoil affects global markets. This relative stability is attributed to Europe's lower exposure to tech giants compared to the US market. Companies in sectors such as energy and financials are supporting earnings growth, which is on track for 25% quarterly profit. Investors remain cautious, noting that broader market selloffs could still impact Europe.

articles.title: Razorpay, Sembcorp Green Infra get Sebi nod to float IPOs
articles.desc: Razorpay Software Ltd and Sembcorp Green Infra recently received approval from Sebi for their initial public offerings, marking a major milestone in their growth journeys. Razorpay aims to secure Rs 5,000-6,000 crore to enhance its financial services platform, while Sembcorp Green Infra plans to raise Rs 3,750 crore to bolster its renewable energy initiatives.

articles.title: Jagatjit Industries Q2 net loss narrows to Rs 4 cr, revenue rises 90%
articles.desc: Jagatjit Industries Ltd has reported a net loss of Rs 3.96 crore for the second quarter of FY27, significantly improving from Rs 27.91 crore lost during the same period last year. Total income surged to Rs 195.43 crore, up from Rs 103.11 crore. In the first half of FY27, the company posted an overall net loss of Rs 12.23 crore, a decrease from Rs 37.81 crore.

articles.title: Amazon's plan to own the world's product data and fight AI shopping agents
articles.desc: Called World Product Graph, the initiative seeks to hoover up data on virtually every item for sale on Earth, whether Amazon stocks it or not, according to an internal document reviewed by Reuters, and to people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: Simplify Alpha™ opens AI engineering and innovation center in Hyderabad, joined by Simplify Healthcare® and SimplifyX™
articles.desc: Hyderabad joins Pune and Mumbai as the third India location for the Simplify Group™ companies, adding capacity for customer delivery and growth.

articles.title: India's gold imports plunge 62.57% to $5.51 billion in October as prices fall below $4,000/oz
articles.desc: India's gold imports fell 39.9% to $24.78 billion during April-October 2026, down from $41.24 billion a year ago, according to Commerce Ministry data. October imports plunged 62.57% year-on-year to $5.51 billion amid a correction in global gold prices. Meanwhile, India's gems and jewellery exports rose to $18.50 billion during the seven-month period.

articles.title: 'I feel it's a sign of what's to come': Office workers on Microsoft outage
articles.desc: Insurance brokers tell Nicky Campbell how their jobs are completely disrupted by the Microsoft outage.

articles.title: Indian rupee snaps rising streak on hawkish Fed, oil rise
articles.desc: In the past week, the Indian rupee faced downward pressure due to escalating oil prices. Although foreign investments offered some relief, they were insufficient to trigger a notable rebound. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to step in to boost forex reserves when the rupee shows strength. Furthermore, India's trade deficit in merchandise hit a yearly peak, compounding the rupee's challenges.

articles.title: Supply shocks to weaken monetary policy effectiveness: CEA
articles.desc: Chief Economic Advisor V Anantha Nageswaran emphasized the diminishing effectiveness of interest rate adjustments in controlling inflation due to supply chain disruptions. He indicated that fiscal policies will play a critical role in addressing these supply-induced challenges. Nageswaran highlighted that many countries have struggled to meet their inflation targets since 2022. He underscored the potential long-term dominance of supply shocks in inflation dynamics.

articles.title: Cisco shares rally after earnings beat: 6 key things investors need to know
articles.desc: Cisco shares surge after strong Q1 FY2027 results, beating analyst estimates. Robust AI data-centre demand drives revenue growth, prompting the networking giant to raise its annual revenue and earnings forecasts.

articles.title: What happened overnight with the Microsoft global outage?
articles.desc: Microsoft is struggling to fix a global outage, with services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot affected by "connectivity problems".

articles.title: Tesla-SpaceX Merger: Musk eyes December deal announcement
articles.desc: Tesla and SpaceX are reportedly advancing merger talks, with a potential December announcement. The proposed $3.5 trillion-plus deal could unite their AI, robotics, automotive and aerospace businesses.

articles.title: EU leaders seek to tackle challenges at first ever AI summit
articles.desc: European Union leaders gather in Dublin on Friday for their first ever summit on artificial intelligence, to debate how the bloc can catch up with the United States and China and tackle funding issues and other problems.

articles.title: MSCI rejig: Which stocks may see the biggest inflows & outflows?
articles.desc: In a significant update, MSCI has revealed modifications to its indices, impacting several Indian stocks starting November 30. This shift is predicted to boost India's representation within the MSCI Emerging Markets Index. Notable stocks like Coforge and LIC are anticipated to attract considerable investments, while PI Industries may experience a decline.

articles.title: Carlsberg said to start road show for $600 million India IPO
articles.desc: Carlsberg is preparing a potential $600 million IPO of its Indian business, targeting a $4 billion valuation. The offering could launch as early as January 2027, comprising a 15% stake sale by its Danish parent. Strong IPO demand in India supports the listing outlook, with Carlsberg India reporting robust revenue.

articles.title: Top pension fund to buy more India state bonds on high yields
articles.desc: SBI Pension Fund plans to increase investments in state government bonds, expecting higher yields amid rising supply. The $64 billion fund is pursuing a carry-focused strategy, favouring state and corporate debt for steady income. It also plans to increase large-cap equity exposure while maintaining a cautious approach towards bond duration.

articles.title: India bonds under pressure before debt supply; hot inflation prints pinch further
articles.desc: Indian government bonds experienced significant selling pressure ahead of a major auction for the benchmark paper. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 bond rose notably due to rising inflation in both India and the United States. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise interest rates again in early December due to persistent inflationary pressures. Moreover, US Treasury yields remained elevated as markets anticipate larger interest rate hikes.

articles.title: Singapore charges fifth person in AI server fraud case
articles.desc: Singapore has charged a fifth person in a case involving the alleged false representation of the end users of AI servers purchased from Dell, Super Micro Computer and Asustek Computer.

articles.title: Food inflation to stay elevated; ICICI Bank sees 25 bps RBI rate hike in December
articles.desc: Food inflation in India is projected to remain elevated in the coming months due to a shortfall in crops. The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to raise interest rates by 25 basis points to manage retail inflation. Factors such as weak monsoon and high energy prices contribute to the rising inflation. Many essential food items are experiencing upward price pressure amid ongoing inflationary trends.

articles.title: Karnataka targets Rs 7.5 lakh crore investments, 20 lakh jobs by 2030; to host Global Investors Meet in April
articles.desc: The targets have been set under the state's Industrial Policy 2025-30, with Karnataka seeking investments in sectors such as semiconductors, aerospace, artificial intelligence, clean energy, life sciences and electric mobility.
